errors.source_span: Simon answered, “Master, we’ve worked hard all night and haven’t caught anything. But because you say so, I will let down the nets.”
errors.translation_span: 西门回答说: "师父啊,我们一夜都劳碌,却没有鱼;但是因你的话,我将网子投下.
errors.explanation: This verse is repeated verbatim at verse 1 in the translation, disrupting the order and causing loss of other verse content and incorrect sequencing.

errors.source_span: When they had done so, they caught such a large number of fish that their nets began to break.
errors.translation_span: 他们这样做,就捕了许多鱼,他们的网就破裂了.
errors.explanation: The translation is accurate and conveys the meaning well.

errors.source_span: So they signaled their partners in the other boat to come and help them, and they came and filled both boats so full that they began to sink.
errors.translation_span: 他们就招呼那船上的同伴来帮助他们.他们来,把两艘船都满了,到底淹没了.
errors.explanation: The translation is clear and accurate.

errors.source_span: When Simon Peter saw this, he fell at Jesus’ knees and said, “Go away from me, Lord; I am a sinful man!”
errors.translation_span: 西门彼得看见这事,就跪在耶稣面前说:主阿,离开我,因为我是罪人.
errors.explanation: The translation accurately renders the content, though "离开我" is slightly less common than another phrasing like '离开我吧', but acceptable.

errors.source_span: For he and all his companions were astonished at the catch of fish they had taken,
errors.translation_span: 因为他和他的同伴们都因他们捕鱼的惊,
errors.explanation: The translation is incomplete; it ends abruptly with '捕鱼的惊' which is an incomplete phrase, causing major loss of meaning.

errors.source_span: and so were James and John, the sons of Zebedee, Simon’s partners.
errors.translation_span: 撒伯底的儿子雅各和约翰,西门的同事也这样.耶稣对西门说:不要害怕,从此你必捕人.
errors.explanation: Translation inaccurately renders 'sons of Zebedee' as '撒伯底的儿子' (should be 撒比大 or 西庇太), and merges verse 10 and 11 improperly. The transition to '耶稣对西门说...' belongs to verse 10-11 but the names and titles are confusing.

errors.source_span: So they pulled their boats up on shore, left everything and followed him.
errors.translation_span: 他们把船到岸边,就离开了一切,跟随了耶稣.
errors.explanation: Translation conveys meaning adequately but wording is slightly terse.

errors.source_span: While Jesus was in one of the towns, a man came along who was covered with leprosy.[b] When he saw Jesus, he fell with his face to the ground and begged him, “Lord, if you are willing, you can make me clean.”
errors.translation_span: 耶稣在那一座城里,有一个满满的男人来到那里.他看见耶稣,俯伏在地上,求耶稣说:"主啊,如果你愿意,你能使我洁净.
errors.explanation: The phrase '满满的男人' is an incorrect translation of 'a man covered with leprosy'; this is a major mistranslation changing the meaning. The rest of the content is reasonably accurate.

errors.source_span: Jesus reached out his hand and touched the man. “I am willing,” he said. “Be clean!” And immediately the leprosy left him.
errors.translation_span: 耶稣伸手摸他,说: 我愿意.你就洁净了.马上,他就从病中消失了.
errors.explanation: The translation is broadly accurate but '他就从病中消失了' is awkward; should indicate 'leprosy left him' rather than 'he disappeared from the illness'.

errors.source_span: Then Jesus ordered him, “Don’t tell anyone, but go, show yourself to the priest and offer the sacrifices that Moses commanded for your cleansing, as a testimony to them.”
errors.translation_span: 耶稣吩咐他说: 不要告诉任何人,但你去向祭司展示自己,献摩西所吩咐的洁净祭,为他们见证.
errors.explanation: The translation roughly conveys the meaning; however, '展示自己' is less common than '显现自己' or '把自己显给祭司看' which may better capture the nuance.

errors.source_span: Yet the news about him spread all the more, so that crowds of people came to hear him and to be healed of their sicknesses.
errors.translation_span: 然而,他的名声越来越传出去,众人都来听他,被治愈他们的病.
errors.explanation: The translation is generally adequate, though '被治愈他们的病' is ungrammatical; better phrasing would be '被治愈' or '得医治'.

errors.source_span: But Jesus often withdrew to lonely places and prayed.
errors.translation_span: 耶稣却往往往旷野去祷告.
errors.explanation: The translation is faithful with a minor redundancy '往往往' instead of '往往'.

errors.source_span: But Jesus often withdrew to lonely places and prayed.
errors.translation_span: 他赦免了一个的,治好了一个的人.
errors.explanation: The phrase '他赦免了一个的,治好了一个的人' is nonsensical and unrelated to the source verse, appearing to add extraneous content, thus a major accuracy error.

errors.source_span: a paralyzed man on a mat
errors.translation_span: 一个子在床上
errors.explanation: The translation omits the critical information that the man is paralyzed; it only says 'a man on a bed', losing the key detail about his paralysis.

errors.source_span: they went up on the roof and lowered him on his mat through the tiles
errors.translation_span: 就上屋顶,把他倒在床上,把他倒在人中间
errors.explanation: The verb '倒' (to pour or topple) is awkward and incorrect here; it should indicate lowering gently. Also the sequence is unclear and grammatically awkward.

errors.source_span: he said to the paralyzed man, “I tell you, get up, take your mat and go home.”
errors.translation_span: 他对子说:我告诉你,起来,拿你的,回家吧.
errors.explanation: The phrase '他对子说' is unclear and seems mistranslated; the object 'mat' is missing after '拿你的'. It should be '拿你的床垫回家吧'.

errors.source_span: No one tears a piece out of a new garment to patch an old one.
errors.translation_span: 没人撕裂新衣服的块,将旧衣服起来.
errors.explanation: The translation is ungrammatical and hard to understand, especially '将旧衣服起来' which does not convey 'to patch an old one'. The meaning that one does not tear a piece from new garment to patch old is distorted.

errors.source_span: Otherwise, they will have torn the new garment, and the patch from the new will not match the old.
errors.translation_span: 不然,新衣服就撕裂了,新衣服的也不和旧衣服一样.
errors.explanation: The translation changes the meaning: it omits the idea that patch from the new won't match the old. Also, '新衣服的也不和旧衣服一样' is vague and unclear. The original meaning about patch mismatch is not accurately translated.

errors.source_span: wineskins
errors.translation_span: 旧的子
errors.explanation: The word '子' is incomplete and vague for 'wineskins'. It should be '皮袋' or '皮囊' to properly convey 'wineskins'.

errors.source_span: wineskins
errors.translation_span: 子
errors.explanation: Repeated incomplete term '子' is unclear and should be properly translated as '皮袋' or '皮囊'.

errors.source_span: One day as Jesus was standing by the Lake of Gennesaret, the people were crowding around him and listening to the word of God.
errors.translation_span: 西门说:"主啊,我们整夜都扎,没什么抓,但因为你说的话,我要把网下去".
errors.explanation: The translation omits the entire setting of Jesus standing by the Lake of Gennesaret with people crowding and listening to God's word, and instead incorrectly starts with Simon speaking.

errors.source_span: He saw at the water’s edge two boats, left there by the fishermen, who were washing their nets.
errors.translation_span: 他看见两艘船站在岸边,渔夫已经从里面下来,正在洗网.
errors.explanation: Translation changes the meaning by saying the fishermen had already gotten down from the boats, whereas the source says the boats were left there by the fishermen who were washing their nets at the water’s edge.

errors.source_span: He got into one of the boats, the one belonging to Simon, and asked him to put out a little from shore. Then he sat down and taught the people from the boat.
errors.translation_span: 耶稣上了其中一艘船,就是西门的,就请他从岸上稍微推开.就坐下,从船里教训众人.
errors.explanation: Translation largely preserves meaning but '稍微推开' literally 'push out slightly' is accurate but a bit informal; acceptable though no penalty needed.

errors.source_span: When he had finished speaking, he said to Simon, “Put out into deep water, and let down the nets for a catch.”
errors.translation_span: 他说完了,就对西门说: 赶船往深处去,把网子放下去,捕鱼.
errors.explanation: The phrase '赶船往深处去' literally means 'drive the boat to the deep', which is a suitable translation; no penalty.

errors.source_span: Simon answered, “Master, we’ve worked hard all night and haven’t caught anything. But because you say so, I will let down the nets.”
errors.translation_span: 西门说:"主啊,我们整夜都扎,没什么抓,但因为你说的话,我要把网下去".
errors.explanation: Translation merges verse 5 content but the phrase '整夜都扎' ('worked hard all night') is unnatural; should be '整夜劳累' or '整夜捕鱼' to better reflect 'we've worked hard all night'. The meaning is mostly preserved, so minor issue.

errors.source_span: When they had done so, they caught such a large number of fish that their nets began to break.
errors.translation_span: 他们这样做了,就捕了许多鱼,他们的网就破了.
errors.explanation: Correctly translated.

errors.source_span: So they signaled their partners in the other boat to come and help them, and they came and filled both boats so full that they began to sink.
errors.translation_span: 他们就向那船上的同伴们招手来帮助他们.他们来,把两艘船都装满了,就差点沉了.
errors.explanation: Adequate translation.

errors.source_span: When Simon Peter saw this, he fell at Jesus’ knees and said, “Go away from me, Lord; I am a sinful man!”
errors.translation_span: 西门彼得看见这事,就跪在耶稣面前,说:"主啊,离开我吧!因为我是个罪人.
errors.explanation: Translation properly conveys content but ends with an incomplete quotation (missing closing quotation mark). Minor punctuation issue, not severe.

errors.source_span: For he and all his companions were astonished at the catch of fish they had taken,
errors.translation_span: 因为他和他同伴们都惊,因为他们所捕的鱼.
errors.explanation: The phrase is awkward and incomplete in Chinese; missing 'astonished' ('惊讶') full form and incomplete sentence structure. Minor fluency issue.

errors.source_span: and so were James and John, the sons of Zebedee, Simon’s partners. Then Jesus said to Simon, “Don’t be afraid; from now on you will fish for people.”
errors.translation_span: 西百代的儿子雅各和约翰,他们也是西门的同事.耶稣对西门说:"不要害怕,从现在起,你就会捕人".
errors.explanation: '西百代的儿子' should be '西门的同伴' or simply '西门的伙伴' and is acceptable. The phrase '捕人' is a literal and acceptable translation of 'fish for people'. No penalty.

errors.source_span: So they pulled their boats up on shore, left everything and followed him.
errors.translation_span: 他们把船带到岸上,就把一切都丢弃,跟着耶稣去.
errors.explanation: Accurate translation.

errors.source_span: While Jesus was in one of the towns, a man came along who was covered with leprosy. When he saw Jesus, he fell with his face to the ground and begged him, “Lord, if you are willing, you can make me clean.”
errors.translation_span: 耶稣在一个城里的时候,有一个人,身体满了.看见耶稣,就俯伏地求他说:"主啊,如果你愿意,你就可以叫我洁净了".
errors.explanation: The phrase '身体满了' omits 'leprosy' and is vague; translation misses the key term for disease. This is a major omission of meaning.

errors.source_span: Jesus reached out his hand and touched the man. “I am willing,” he said. “Be clean!” And immediately the leprosy left him.
errors.translation_span: 耶稣伸出手摸他,说:"我愿意,你洁净吧!"他就马上就脱了大.
errors.explanation: The phrase '他就马上就脱了大' is a mistranslation and nonsensical. The source means the leprosy left him immediately, but the Chinese text incorrectly says he 'immediately took off big'. This is a critical error affecting meaning.

errors.source_span: Then Jesus ordered him, “Don’t tell anyone, but go, show yourself to the priest and offer the sacrifices that Moses commanded for your cleansing, as a testimony to them.”
errors.translation_span: 耶稣吩咐他说: 不要告诉任何人.你要去向祭司看自己,为你的洁净献上摩西所吩咐的,为证据给他们.
errors.explanation: '去向祭司看自己' is an inaccurate translation; should be '去把自己给祭司看' or '去见祭司' to reflect instructing him to show himself to the priest. This causes comprehension difficulty. Major error.

errors.source_span: Yet the news about him spread all the more, so that crowds of people came to hear him and to be healed of their sicknesses.
errors.translation_span: 然而,耶稣的名声越来越传,许多人聚集来听他的话,要从他们的疾病中得救.
errors.explanation: The phrase '要从他们的疾病中得救' means 'want to be saved from their diseases' which is a reasonable adaptation of 'to be healed' and acceptable.

errors.source_span: But Jesus often withdrew to lonely places and prayed.
errors.translation_span: 耶稣常往旷野去祷告,赦免子,治好子.
errors.explanation: The addition of '赦免子,治好子' (forgive people, heal people) is not in the source and is an addition that changes meaning. This is a major accuracy/addition error.

errors.source_span: a paralyzed man on a mat
errors.translation_span: 一个子在床上
errors.explanation: The translation omits the key information that the man is 'paralyzed', making the condition of the man unclear.

errors.source_span: lowered him on his mat through the tiles into the middle of the crowd, right in front of Jesus
errors.translation_span: 在子里把他带着床子下去
errors.explanation: The phrase '在子里' is ungrammatical and unclear in Chinese, affecting fluency and clarity.

errors.source_span: a large crowd of tax collectors and others were eating with them
errors.translation_span: 有许多税吏和其他人同他们同席
errors.explanation: The translation changes 'were eating with them' into '同席' (sharing a seat), which can imply a different social nuance than eating together, although generally acceptable as a paraphrase.

errors.source_span: the new wine will burst the skins
errors.translation_span: 新酒就会破裂子
errors.explanation: The phrase '破裂子' is ungrammatical and unclear in Chinese, causing a significant distortion of the meaning 'burst the skins'. The correct meaning that the wineskins will burst is not properly conveyed.

errors.translation_span: 新酒就会破裂子
errors.explanation: The phrase is grammatically incorrect and awkward in Chinese, with the word '破裂子' being non-standard and unclear.

errors.source_span: spent the night praying to __MOST_HIGH_A__
errors.translation_span: 花费 这 夜晚 __REQUEST_A__ 到 __MOST_HIGH_A__
errors.explanation: The translation uses the placeholder '__REQUEST_A__' instead of translating 'praying', causing omission of the core meaning of 'prayed'. This loses the meaning that he spent the night in prayer, which is significant.

errors.source_span: Those troubled by impure spirits were cured
errors.translation_span: 那些 陷入困境的 经过 不纯的 烈酒 是 治愈了
errors.explanation: The phrase 'impure spirits' is mistranslated as '不纯的 烈酒' ('impure strong liquor') instead of '邪灵' or '污秽的灵' meaning impure spirits/demons.

errors.source_span: Those troubled by impure spirits were cured
errors.translation_span: 那些 陷入困境的 经过 不纯的 烈酒 是 治愈了
errors.explanation: The sentence structure in Chinese is awkward and does not correctly convey the original meaning.

errors.source_span: because power was coming from him and healing them all
errors.translation_span: 因为 力量 曾是 未来 从 他 和 康复 他们 全部
errors.explanation: The phrase '力量 曾是 未来 从 他' is ungrammatical and unclear, mistranslating 'power was coming from him'.

errors.source_span: for yours is the kingdom of __MOST_HIGH_A__
errors.translation_span: 为了 你的 是 这 王国 的 __最_高_a__
errors.explanation: The placeholder '__MOST_HIGH_A__' is inconsistently capitalized and spaced as '__最_高_a__' in translation; inconsistent representation of the title/name.

errors.source_span: because of the Son of Man
errors.translation_span: 因为 的 这 儿子 的 男人
errors.explanation: The phrase '儿子 的 男人' is a literal and unnatural word-by-word translation of 'Son of Man' instead of the standard '人子' in Chinese, obscuring meaning.

errors.source_span: because great is your reward in heaven
errors.translation_span: 因为 伟大的 是 你的 报酬 在 天堂
errors.explanation: The word order and phrasing is unnatural and awkward in Chinese; the intended meaning is recoverable but the expression is not idiomatic.

errors.source_span: Woe to you who are well fed now
errors.translation_span: 祸患 到 你 WHO 是 出色地 美联储 现在
errors.explanation: '出色地 美联储' is nonsense in Chinese and unrelated to 'well fed'; it appears to be a mistranslation or error caused by word-by-word machine translation.

errors.source_span: because that is how their ancestors treated the false prophets
errors.translation_span: 为了 那 是 如何 他们的 祖先 治疗过的 这 错误的 先知
errors.explanation: The verb '治疗过的' means 'treated medically/cured' which is inappropriate here; the correct meaning is 'treated' in a hostile, rejecting sense.

errors.source_span: If someone slaps you on one cheek, turn to them the other also
errors.translation_span: 如果 某人 打耳光 你 在 一 脸颊， 转动 到 他们 这 其他 还
errors.explanation: '转动' means 'rotate' and does not convey 'turn the other cheek' idiomatically; the phrase is awkward and unclear.

errors.source_span: If someone takes your coat, do not withhold your shirt from them
errors.translation_span: 如果 某人 需要 你的 外套， 做 不是 扣压 你的 衬衫 从 他们
errors.explanation: '需要' means 'need' instead of 'takes'; '扣压' is an incorrect translation of 'withhold'; meaning is distorted.

errors.source_span: and if anyone takes what belongs to you, do not demand it back
errors.translation_span: 和 如果 任何人 需要 什么 属于 到 你， 做 不是 要求 它 后退
errors.explanation: '需要' ('need') is misused instead of 'takes'; '要求 它 后退' ('demand it back') is unnatural and awkward.

errors.source_span: Do to others as you would have them do to you
errors.translation_span: 做 到 其他的 作为 你 会 有 他们 做 到 你
errors.explanation: The Chinese translation is a word-by-word rendering and is awkward and ungrammatical, making it hard to understand naturally.

errors.source_span: If you love those who love you, what credit is that to you?
errors.translation_span: 如果 你 爱 那些 WHO 爱 你， 什么 信用 是 那 到 你？
errors.explanation: The placement of '到' is unnatural and the sentence overall is awkwardly structured.

errors.source_span: And if you lend to those from whom you expect repayment, what credit is that to you?
errors.translation_span: 和 如果 你 借 到 那些 从 谁 你 预计 还款， 什么 信用 是 那 到 你？
errors.explanation: The phrase '借 到' and '从 谁 你 预计 还款' is unnatural and incorrect; it does not convey the sense of 'lend to those expecting repayment' properly.

errors.source_span: Then your reward will be great, and you will be children of the __HONORED_A__, because he is kind to the ungrateful and wicked
errors.translation_span: 然后 你的 报酬 将要 是 伟大的， 和 你 将要 是 孩子们 的 这 __HONORED_A__, 因为 他 是 种类 到 这 忘恩负义 和 邪恶
errors.explanation: The placeholder '__HONORED_A__' is untranslated and in English, inconsistent with the rest of the translation; '种类 到 这 忘恩负义' is ungrammatical and unclear for 'kind to the ungrateful'.

errors.source_span: Do not judge, and you will not be judged. Do not condemn, and you will not be condemned. Forgive, and you will be forgiven.
errors.translation_span: 做 不是 法官， 和 你 将要 不是 是 判断。 做 不是 谴责， 和 你 将要 不是 是 谴责。 原谅， 和 你 将要 是 原谅。
errors.explanation: The translation incorrectly translates 'Do not judge' as '做 不是 法官' (do not be a judge), changing the meaning from 'do not judge' (verb) to 'do not be a judge' (noun). Similar issues with 'condemn' and 'forgive'. The negation structure is also awkward and potentially confusing.

errors.source_span: Give, and it will be given to you. A good measure, pressed down, shaken together and running over, will be poured into your lap.
errors.translation_span: 给， 和 它 将要 是 给定 到 你。 一个 好的 措施， 按下 向下， 动摇 一起 和 跑步 超过， 将要 是 倒 进入 你的 一圈。
errors.explanation: The phrase 'pressed down, shaken together and running over' is awkwardly translated as '按下 向下， 动摇 一起 和 跑步 超过', which is a literal but nonsensical word-by-word translation. The phrase 'poured into your lap' is translated as '倒 进入 你的 一圈' where '一圈' does not convey 'lap' correctly.

errors.source_span: Can the blind lead the blind? Will they not both fall into a pit?
errors.translation_span: 能 这 瞎的 带领 这 瞎的？ 将要 他们 不是 两个都 落下 进入 一个 坑？
errors.explanation: Literal, word-for-word translation results in ungrammatical Chinese with unnatural word order and phrasing. '将要 他们 不是 两个都 落下' is confusing and does not correctly translate 'Will they not both fall'.

errors.source_span: The student is not above the teacher, but everyone who is fully trained will be like their teacher.
errors.translation_span: 这 学生 是 不是 多于 这 老师， 但 每个人 WHO 是 完全 训练有素的 将要 是 喜欢 他们的 老师。
errors.explanation: Unnatural word order and incomplete translation. The phrase 'WHO 是 完全 训练有素的' improperly includes the English word 'WHO'. '将要 是 喜欢 他们的 老师' incorrectly uses '喜欢' (like) instead of '像' (like), and the overall sentence is awkward and confusing.

errors.source_span: Why do you look at the speck of sawdust in your brother’s eye and pay no attention to the plank in your own eye?
errors.translation_span: 为什么 做 你 看 在 这 斑点 的 锯末 在 你的 兄弟 眼睛 和 支付 不 注意力 到 这 板 在 你的 自己的 眼睛？
errors.explanation: Unnatural and awkward phrasing with literal word-by-word translation. '做 你 看' is incorrect grammar; '支付 不 注意力' is a clumsy direct translation for 'pay no attention to.'

errors.source_span: How can you say to your brother, ‘Brother, let me take the speck out of your eye,’ when you yourself fail to see the plank in your own eye? You hypocrite, first take the plank out of your eye, and then you will see clearly to remove the speck from your brother’s eye.
errors.translation_span: 如何 能 你 说 到 你的 兄弟， '兄弟， 让 我 拿 这 斑点 出去 的 你的 眼睛，' 什么时候 你 你自己 失败 到 看 这 板 在 你的 自己的 眼睛？ 你 伪君子， 第一的 拿 这 板 出去 的 你的 眼睛， 和 然后 你 将要 看 清楚地 到 消除 这 斑点 从 你的 兄弟 眼睛。
errors.explanation: Repeated pronouns and awkward phrasing such as '失败 到 看' (fail to see) and '第一的 拿' (first take). The connective phrases and modal verbs make it difficult to read and understand.

errors.source_span: People do not pick figs from thornbushes, or grapes from briers.
errors.translation_span: 人们 做 不是 挑选 无花果 从 荆棘丛, 或者 葡萄 从 荆棘。
errors.explanation: Translated '荆棘丛' and '荆棘' inconsistently ('thornbushes' and 'briers'). Also, literal word-by-word translation leads to lack of fluency. Missing the 'from' particle in 'do not pick from thornbushes'.

errors.source_span: For the mouth speaks what the heart is full of.
errors.translation_span: 为了 这 嘴 说话 什么 这 心 是 满的 的。
errors.explanation: Literal word-by-word translation with unnatural word order and redundant particles resulting in awkward and unclear phrasing.

errors.source_span: As for everyone who comes to me and hears my words and puts them into practice, I will show you what they are like.
errors.translation_span: 作为 为了 每个人 WHO 来了 到 我 和 听到 我的 字 和 看跌期权 他们 进入 实践， 我 将要 展示 你 什么 他们 是 喜欢。
errors.explanation: Includes untranslated English words 'WHO' and '看跌期权' ('put option', unrelated term), showing clear errors and undermining comprehension. The sentence is ungrammatical and hard to understand.

errors.source_span: They are like a man building a house, who dug down deep and laid the foundation on rock.
errors.translation_span: 他们 是 喜欢 一个 男人 建筑 一个 房子， WHO 挖 向下 深的 和 铺设 这 基础 在 岩石。
errors.explanation: Unnatural phrasing and word order. Use of 'WHO' in English is incorrect. '挖 向下 深的' and '铺设 这 基础' are awkward and not idiomatic Chinese.

errors.source_span: But the one who hears my words and does not put them into practice is like a man who built a house on the ground without a foundation.
errors.translation_span: 但 这 一 WHO 听到 我的 字 和 做 不是 放 他们 进入 实践 是 喜欢 一个 男人 WHO 建成 一个 房子 在 这 地面 没有 一个 基础。
errors.explanation: Inclusion of English 'WHO' twice is inappropriate. The phrase '做 不是 放 他们 进入 实践' is awkward and inaccurate. Overall sentence is stilted and difficult to understand.

errors.source_span: One Sabbath __PERSON_F__ was going through the grainfields, and his disciples began to pick some heads of grain, rub them in their hands and eat the kernels.
errors.translation_span: 另一天安息日，他进会堂教导，有个人右手枯干。
errors.explanation: The translation omits the whole episode of __PERSON_F__ and his disciples going through grainfields and picking grain. Instead, it starts with a different event about entering the synagogue and a man with a shriveled hand, which is from verse 6.

errors.source_span: On another Sabbath he went into the synagogue and was teaching, and a man was there whose right hand was shriveled.
errors.translation_span: 1 另一天安息日，他进会堂教导，有个人右手枯干。
errors.explanation: This verse is repeated and misnumbered in the translation (marked as verse 1 again). The content corresponds to verse 6, but it appears out of order and replaces verse 1's content.

errors.source_span: from all over Judea, from __CITY_A__, and from the coastal region around Tyre and Sidon,
errors.translation_span: 很多犹太各地、__CITY_A__、推罗西顿海边地区的人
errors.explanation: The translation does not translate '__CITY_A__' but leaves it as a placeholder, which is acceptable if it consistently preserves the source referent.

errors.source_span: who had come to hear him and to be healed of their diseases
errors.translation_span: 没有对应部分
errors.explanation: The translation omits the phrase about people coming to hear Jesus and to be healed from their diseases, only mentioning those troubled by impure spirits.

errors.source_span: and the people all tried to touch him
errors.translation_span: 人人都想摸他
errors.explanation: The Chinese translation uses a general expression 'everyone wanted to touch him,' which may be acceptable but loses the nuance of 'all tried to touch him'.

errors.source_span: the kingdom of __MOST_HIGH_A__
errors.translation_span: __MOST_HIGH_A__ 的国民
errors.explanation: The translation renders 'kingdom of __MOST_HIGH_A__' as '国民' (citizens) of the kingdom, changing the noun from 'kingdom' to 'citizens,' which is a terminological inaccuracy.

errors.source_span: Woe to you when everyone speaks well of you
errors.translation_span: 人人说你们好有祸了
errors.explanation: The translation incorrectly renders the blessing 'Woe to you when everyone speaks well of you' as 'Everyone says you are good, woe to you,' confusing blessing and woe.

errors.source_span: you will be children of the __HONORED_A__
errors.translation_span: 你们是 __HONORED_A__ 的儿女
errors.explanation: The term '__HONORED_A__' is untranslated placeholder; acceptable if consistent, but ideally should be localized.

errors.source_span: A good measure, pressed down, shaken together and running over, will be poured into your lap.
errors.translation_span: 用满着挤压摇动满溢的量倒入你怀里。
errors.explanation: The Chinese phrase is awkward and unnatural, lacking fluidity in describing the measure being "pressed down, shaken together and running over." A more idiomatic phrasing would improve fluency.

errors.source_span: speck of sawdust
errors.translation_span: 木屑
errors.explanation: The source image implies a very small particle (sawdust), but '木屑' typically means wood shavings which can be larger; a more precise term like '小刺' or '刺儿' might better capture the meaning.

errors.source_span: plank
errors.translation_span: 梁木
errors.explanation: The term '梁木' (beam) is accurate but somewhat formal/classical; '木梁' or '木板' might be more common in modern usage, though not incorrect.

errors.source_span: A good man brings good things out of the good stored up in his heart, and an evil man brings evil things out of the evil stored up in his heart.
errors.translation_span: 好人从心里储存的善，发出善来。坏人从恶心发恶来。
errors.explanation: The phrase '坏人从恶心发恶来' is slightly awkward and might be misunderstood as referring to 'nausea' (恶心). A clearer phrasing would avoid ambiguity, for example '坏人从心里所存的恶发出恶来'.

errors.source_span: One Sabbath __PERSON_F__ was going through the grainfields, and his disciples began to pick some heads of grain, rub them in their hands and eat the kernels.
errors.translation_span: 另一个安息日，他进了会堂教导，有一个男人的右手枯萎。
errors.explanation: The translation omits the event of __PERSON_F__ going through the grainfields and the disciples picking grain; instead it repeats part of verse 6, causing significant omission and confusion.

errors.source_span: On another Sabbath he went into the synagogue and was teaching, and a man was there whose right hand was shriveled.
errors.translation_span: 另一个安息日，他进了会堂教导，有一个男人的右手枯萎。
errors.explanation: This verse is repeated twice as verse 1 and 6 in the translation, which indicates an omission of the actual content of verse 6 in the translation.

errors.source_span: Some of the Pharisees asked, “Why are you doing what is unlawful on the Sabbath?”
errors.translation_span: 一些法利赛人问：“你们为什么在安息日做不合规矩的事？”
errors.explanation: Translation uses '不合规矩的事' ('things not according to rules') which is an interpretive paraphrase; however, it retains the core meaning and is acceptable, so no penalty.

errors.source_span: One of those days __PERSON_F__ went out to a mountainside to pray, and spent the night __REQUEST_A__ to __MOST_HIGH_A__.
errors.translation_span: 那些日子里，__PERSON_F__ 上山祷告，一夜向 __MOST_HIGH_A__ 请求。
errors.explanation: Translation renders 'spent the night __REQUEST_A__ to __MOST_HIGH_A__' as '一夜向 __MOST_HIGH_A__ 请求', but omits the nuance of 'praying' or the sense of a full night's prayer or supplication, causing an incomplete and potentially misleading meaning.

errors.source_span: ... and a great number of people from all over Judea, from __CITY_A__, and from the coastal region around Tyre and Sidon,
errors.translation_span: ...许多他的门徒和来自犹太各地、从 __CITY_A__，以及泰尔和西顿沿海地区的人群聚集，他们来听他讲道和治愈疾病。
errors.explanation: Translation adds '他们来听他讲道和治愈疾病' ('they came to hear him preach and heal diseases'), which is not explicitly stated in the source. This is a minor addition that extends but does not distort meaning.

errors.source_span: who had come to hear him and to be healed of their diseases.
errors.translation_span: 被污灵缠身的人得医治，
errors.explanation: The Chinese translation omits 'who had come to hear him and to be healed of their diseases,' only mentioning those troubled by impure spirits being healed, thus missing part of the source meaning.

errors.source_span: for yours is the kingdom of __MOST_HIGH_A__.
errors.translation_span: 因为天国是你们的。
errors.explanation: The source explicitly states 'the kingdom of __MOST_HIGH_A__' (God or the Most High), but the translation simply says 'the kingdom of heaven,' which is a different term and could lead to a theological divergence.

errors.source_span: If someone takes your coat, do not withhold your shirt from them.
errors.translation_span: 如果有人拿你的外衣，不要拒绝他内衣。
errors.explanation: The translation uses '不拒绝他内衣' (do not refuse him the inner garment), which is a reasonable paraphrase but could be clearer as 'do not withhold your shirt.' It may be slightly ambiguous whether '内衣' corresponds precisely to 'shirt.'

errors.source_span: you will be children of the __HONORED_A__, because he is kind to the ungrateful and wicked.
errors.translation_span: 你们是 __HONORED_A__ 的儿女，因为他恩待忘恩和恶人。
errors.explanation: The source refers to 'children of the Father' (implied by __HONORED_A__), but the translation omits the explicit 'Father' concept or proper name, potentially losing the personal referent and sacred title.

errors.source_span: A good measure, pressed down, shaken together and running over
errors.translation_span: 有分量、连摇带压、盈满
errors.explanation: The translation renders the imagery correctly but merges the phrases 'pressed down, shaken together and running over' into '连摇带压、盈满', which slightly compresses the original sequence, but the meaning is preserved and acceptable.

errors.source_span: For the mouth speaks what the heart is full of
errors.translation_span: 因为嘴里所说的是心里所充满的
errors.explanation: The Chinese translation changes the abstract 'what the heart is full of' to '心里所充满的' which is accurate and consistent; no error.

errors.source_span: “Why do you call me, '__MASTER_A__, __MASTER_A__,' and do not do what I say?
errors.translation_span: “你们为什么称我‘__MASTER_A__，__MASTER_A__’，却不照我说的去做呢？
errors.explanation: The key phrase is translated accurately, including the placeholder, so no error.

errors.source_span: 48 They are like a man building a house, who dug down deep and laid the foundation on rock. When a flood came, the torrent struck that house but could not shake it, because it was well built.
errors.translation_span: [MISSING VERSE]
errors.explanation: Verse 48 is completely missing in the Chinese translation, omitting crucial descriptive content that supports the parable's message.

errors.source_span: One Sabbath __PERSON_F__ was going through the grainfields, and his disciples began to pick some heads of grain, rub them in their hands and eat the kernels.
errors.translation_span: 1 另一个安息日，__PERSON_F__ 进入会堂教导，有一个人右手萎缩在那里。
errors.explanation: The translation replaces the grainfields scene with the synagogue scene from verse 6, omitting the original action of __PERSON_F__ and his disciples in the grainfields.

errors.source_span: who had come to hear him and to be healed of their diseases. Those troubled by impure spirits were cured
errors.translation_span: 困扰着污灵的人都被治好，
errors.explanation: The translation omits ‘who had come to hear him and to be healed of their diseases.’ It only mentions those troubled by impure spirits being healed but omits those who came to hear and be healed of diseases.

errors.source_span: and the people all tried to touch him, because power was coming from him and healing them all
errors.translation_span: 人们都试图摸他，因为他的能力从他身上出来，医治了所有人。
errors.explanation: The translation conveys the general meaning but slightly omits the emphasis on ‘all’ people trying to touch him. The phrase is somewhat paraphrased but acceptable.

errors.source_span: for yours is the kingdom of __MOST_HIGH_A__
errors.translation_span: 因为天国是你们的。
errors.explanation: The source refers to the ‘kingdom of __MOST_HIGH_A__’ (likely ‘the Most High’ or God), but the translation says simply ‘天国’ (the kingdom of heaven), which is a common equivalent but omits the specified title from the placeholder.

errors.source_span: If someone slaps you on one cheek, turn to them the other also. If someone takes your coat, do not withhold your shirt from them.
errors.translation_span: 若有人打你的右脸，连左脸也转过来由他打。若有人拿你的外衣，连内衣也不要拒绝他。
errors.explanation: The translation changes ‘do not withhold your shirt from them’ into ‘连内衣也不要拒绝他’ which suggests actively giving the inner garment, rather than not withholding, adding a stronger meaning potentially more than the source text intends.

errors.source_span: if anyone takes what belongs to you, do not demand it back
errors.translation_span: 若有人拿你的物件，不要要回来。
errors.explanation: The translation uses ‘物件’ (objects/things) which is a general term instead of ‘what belongs to you.’ This is acceptable, but ‘物件’ might be slightly less precise.

errors.source_span: children of the __HONORED_A__, because he is kind to the ungrateful and wicked.
errors.translation_span: 你们要作 __HONORED_A__ 的儿子，因为他恩待忘恩负义和恶人。
errors.explanation: The placeholder __HONORED_A__ is untranslated, but this is consistent and acceptable per instructions.

errors.source_span: pressed down, shaken together and running over
errors.translation_span: 用好量、紧捣、摇出来并满溢
errors.explanation: The phrase 'pressed down' is translated as '用好量、紧捣', which is somewhat literal but acceptable. The sequence and clarity could be improved; 'pressed down' and 'shaken together' are translated with slight awkward phrasing, but meaning is clear. No major error.

errors.source_span: the torrent struck that house
errors.translation_span: 洪水猛兽来，冲刷那房子
errors.explanation: The source uses 'torrent' (a fast-flowing stream of water), while the Chinese translation uses '洪水猛兽' (literally 'flood and fierce beasts'), which adds '猛兽' (fierce beasts) beyond the source. This addition slightly alters the imagery but does not change the overall meaning critically.

errors.source_span: One Sabbath Jesus was going through the grainfields, and his disciples began to pick some heads of grain, rub them in their hands and eat the kernels.
errors.translation_span: 在另一个安息日,他走进犹太教堂,教人教诲。有一个人的右手在那个安息日被打碎。
errors.explanation: The source describes Jesus going through grainfields and disciples picking grain, but the translation incorrectly describes Jesus entering a synagogue and teaching, with mention of a man with a shriveled hand, which belongs to verse 6, not verse 1.

errors.source_span: Some of the Pharisees asked, “Why are you doing what is unlawful on the Sabbath?”
errors.translation_span: 法老的一些人说:你们怎么在安息日做恶事呢?
errors.explanation: 'Pharisees' is mistranslated as '法老'(Pharaoh), which is an incorrect and misleading translation.

errors.source_span: Jesus answered them, “Have you never read what David did when he and his companions were hungry?
errors.translation_span: 耶稣对他们说:难道你没有读过戴维和他的同伴们在挨饿时所做的事吗?
errors.explanation: 'David' is mistranslated as '戴维', while biblically the standard transliteration is '大卫' — this is a terminology inconsistency in this context.

errors.source_span: He entered the house of God, and taking the consecrated bread, he ate what is lawful only for priests to eat. And he also gave some to his companions.
errors.translation_span: 他走进真主的房屋,吃下庄稼的食品,他吃下对于祭司是合法的食物,他还以一部分供给他的同伴。
errors.explanation: 'House of God' is translated as '真主的房屋' (referring to 'Allah' in Islamic context), which is incorrect for the Christian biblical context. The phrase should be translated as '神的殿' or similar. Also, 'consecrated bread' is rendered as '庄稼的食品', which is inaccurate and vague.

errors.source_span: Then Jesus said to them, “The Son of Man is Lord of the Sabbath.”
errors.translation_span: 尔撒对他们说:人的儿子是安息日的主。
errors.explanation: 'Jesus' is mistranslated as '尔撒', which is not the standard transliteration. This is a terminology error that may confuse readers.

errors.source_span: On another Sabbath he went into the synagogue and was teaching, and a man was there whose right hand was shriveled.
errors.translation_span: 在另一个安息日,他走进犹太教堂,教人教诲。有一个人的右手在那个安息日被打碎。
errors.explanation: This translation duplicates the incorrect text from verse 1 and contains an inaccurate description. The right hand was 'shriveled' or 'withered', not '打碎'(broken). Also, 'synagogue' should be translated as '会堂' or '犹太会堂', not '犹太教堂'.

errors.source_span: The Pharisees and the teachers of the law were looking for a reason to accuse Jesus, so they watched him closely to see if he would heal on the Sabbath.
errors.translation_span: 法利赛人和法律的老师 正在寻找一个理由 指责耶稣, 所以他们密切注视他 看他是否 将治愈安息日。
errors.explanation: 'Teachers of the law' is oversimplified as '法律的老师' rather than the established term '律法师'. The phrase 'to see if he would heal on the Sabbath' is mistranslated as '看他是否 将治愈安息日', which is nonsensical and misses the meaning—should be '是否会在安息日治病'.

errors.source_span: But Jesus knew what they were thinking and said to the man with the shriveled hand, “Get up and stand in front of everyone.” So he got up and stood there.
errors.translation_span: 但耶穌知道他们的想法,他用的手对那个人说:你们起来,站在众人面前吧!他就站起来,站在那里。
errors.explanation: The translation says '他用的手对那个人说' ('he used his hand to speak to the man'), which is a mistranslation of 'he said to the man with the shriveled hand'. The meaning is confused.

errors.source_span: Then Jesus said to them, “I ask you, which is lawful on the Sabbath: to do good or to do evil, to save life or to destroy it?”
errors.translation_span: 尔撒对他们说:我求你在安息日做善事,或做恶事,或拯救生命,或加以毁灭。
errors.explanation: Again, 'Jesus' is mistranslated as '尔撒'. The sentence also lacks the interrogative tone 'which is lawful on the Sabbath' and reads as a statement rather than a question.

errors.source_span: He looked around at them all, and then said to the man, “Stretch out your hand.” He did so, and his hand was completely restored.
errors.translation_span: 他看着他们,然后对人说:你们把手伸出来吧!他这样做了,他的手完全复原了。
errors.explanation: The translation uses '你们' (plural 'you') instead of singular '你' when Jesus speaks to the man; also '对人说' is vague; it should specify '对那人说'.

errors.source_span: But the Pharisees and the teachers of the law were furious and began to discuss with one another what they might do to Jesus.
errors.translation_span: 法老和法老的老师们,都发怒了,他们彼此商议他们对耶稣的所作所为。
errors.explanation: Again 'Pharisees' is mistranslated as '法老'(Pharaoh), and 'teachers of the law' as '法老的老师们'—both incorrect and inconsistent.

errors.source_span: When morning came, he called his disciples to him and chose twelve of them, whom he also designated apostles:
errors.translation_span: 当早晨,他召唤他的门徒们来教化他,他从其中拣选了十二位门徒,并指定了十二位门徒。
errors.explanation: The phrase 'whom he also designated apostles' is awkwardly and incorrectly translated as '并指定了十二位门徒', repeating 'twelve disciples' rather than clearly rendering 'designated apostles' (使徒). Also, '叫来教化他' is incorrect; it should be '召唤门徒到他跟前' or similar.

errors.source_span: Simon who was called the Zealot
errors.translation_span: 西蒙 被称为扎洛特
errors.explanation: The transliteration '扎洛特' is a non-standard transliteration of 'Zealot'—commonly the term is transliterated as '热心党' or '激进党'. This may cause confusion but is a minor terminology issue.

errors.source_span: Those troubled by impure spirits were cured,
errors.translation_span: 为不洁的精神而烦恼的人们,确已获得治疗了。
errors.explanation: The phrase is translated as '为不洁的精神而烦恼的人们' ('people troubled by unclean spirits') which is understandable but less natural. 'impure spirits' usually translates as '污灵' or '污鬼'. Also, 'were cured' is translated as '获得治疗了' ('obtained treatment') instead of '被治愈'.

errors.source_span: and the people all tried to touch him, because power was coming from him and healing them all.
errors.translation_span: 所有人都想摸他 因为力量来自他 治愈了他们
errors.explanation: The translation omits 'all' (people all tried to touch him) and oversimplifies 'healing them all' to '治愈了他们' which may imply only some were healed rather than all, losing emphasis on universality.

errors.source_span: Blessed are you who are poor, for yours is the kingdom of God.
errors.translation_span: 你们这些穷困的人,有福哉你们!因为你们的国权确是真主的。
errors.explanation: The phrase '国权确是真主的' is mistranslated; 'kingdom of God' should be translated as 神的国 or 天国. The term '真主' is specific to Islam and is not appropriate in a Christian biblical context.

errors.source_span: Blessed are you who hunger now, for you will be satisfied. Blessed are you who weep now, for you will laugh.
errors.translation_span: 饥 渴 的 你 們 有 福 了 . 因 為 你 們 必 得 满足 . 哀哭 的 你 們 有 福 了 . 因 你 們 必 笑
errors.explanation: The excessive spacing and unusual formatting in the phrase reduces fluency but does not affect meaning significantly.

errors.source_span: Blessed are you when people hate you, when they exclude you and insult you and reject your name as evil, because of the Son of Man.
errors.translation_span: 当人们因为人类之子而憎恨你 排斥你 侮辱你 否认你的恶名
errors.explanation: Translation omits 'when they exclude you and insult you and reject your name as evil' completely and mistranslates 'Son of Man' as '人类之子' instead of proper term '人子'. This changes the meaning and loses important elements.

errors.source_span: Woe to you who are well fed now, for you will go hungry. Woe to you who laugh now, for you will mourn and weep.
errors.translation_span: 哀哉你们!你们将因饥饿而得食物,你们将因哀悼而哭泣。
errors.explanation: '你们将因饥饿而得食物' is a mistranslation reversing the meaning; the source says those well fed now will go hungry, but the translation says they will get food because of hunger. Also, '哀悼' is 'mourning' but the sequence is inaccurately rendered and misaligned with the original.

errors.source_span: Woe to you when everyone speaks well of you, for that is how their ancestors treated the false prophets.
errors.translation_span: 当众人谈论你的时候,伤哉你们!他们的祖先就是这样对待伪先知的。
errors.explanation: The phrase 'when everyone speaks well of you' is mistranslated as '当众人谈论你的时候' which means 'when everyone talks about you' without specifying positive speech, losing the contrast in the source.

errors.source_span: If someone slaps you on one cheek, turn to them the other also. If someone takes your coat, do not withhold your shirt from them.
errors.translation_span: 如果有人扇你一巴掌,就把另一巴掌还给他们。如果有人拿了你的外套,就不要把衬衫扣在他们身上。
errors.explanation: The phrase 'turn to them the other also' is mistranslated as '把另一巴掌还给他们' which means 'slap back the other cheek', the exact opposite of the message. Also, '不要把衬衫扣在他们身上' is nonsensical here instead of '不要拒绝给他们衬衫' (do not withhold your shirt). This reverses the intended meaning.

errors.source_span: Do to others as you would have them do to you.
errors.translation_span: 做别人,你会让他们做你。
errors.explanation: The translation is nonsensical and distorted. It should be a version of '你们愿意人怎样待你们，你们也要怎样待人', but here it is '做别人,你会让他们做你', meaning 'be others, you will let them be you', which is incorrect and meaningless.

errors.source_span: And if you lend to those from whom you expect repayment, what credit is that to you? Even sinners lend to sinners, expecting to be repaid in full.
errors.translation_span: 如果你们借给那些你们所希望偿还的人,那对于你们有什么裨益呢?罪人也借给罪人,希望他们获得完全的报酬。
errors.explanation: '希望他们获得完全的报酬' is a poor translation of 'expecting to be repaid in full', and may confuse 'repayment' with 'reward'. It should be '期待全额偿还'.

errors.source_span: But love your enemies, do good to them, and lend to them without expecting to get anything back. Then your reward will be great, and you will be children of the Most High, because he is kind to the ungrateful and wicked.
errors.translation_span: 你们应当喜爱你们的敌人,应当以善待他们,应当以善待他们,而不受亏待。然后,你们的报酬是重大的,你们将来是至尊的,他对于忘恩负义的,是善良的。
errors.explanation: Repetition of '应当以善待他们' is redundant and unnatural. '而不受亏待' is an awkward translation of 'without expecting to get anything back'. '你们将来是至尊的' mistranslates 'children of the Most High' as '至尊' (supreme one) instead of '至高者的儿女'. These distort key theological meanings.

errors.source_span: Do not judge, and you will not be judged. Do not condemn, and you will not be condemned. Forgive, and you will be forgiven.
errors.translation_span: 你不要判决,不要判决,不要责备,不要责备,不要责备,不要责备,要赦宥,要赦宥。
errors.explanation: The translation repeats words redundantly and excessively ('不要判决' twice, '不要责备' four times, '要赦宥' twice) leading to poor fluency and unnatural style, deviating from the source's balanced parallelism.

errors.source_span: Give, and it will be given to you. A good measure, pressed down, shaken together and running over, will be poured into your lap. For with the measure you use, it will be measured to you.
errors.translation_span: 你应当施舍,而且应当施舍,你应当施舍,你应当施舍,你应当用精美的斗和公平的秤,你应当用精美的秤秤来给养你们。
errors.explanation: The translation repeats '你应当施舍' multiple times unnecessarily and introduces '精美的斗和公平的秤', which is not in the source and thus adds content altering the meaning. The nuanced description of 'pressed down, shaken together and running over' is lost.

errors.source_span: Why do you look at the speck of sawdust in your brother’s eye and pay no attention to the plank in your own eye?
errors.translation_span: “为什么你看着你哥哥眼中的锯木屑,却不注意自己眼中的木板呢?
errors.explanation: The source figurative terms 'speck' and 'plank' are mistranslated as '锯木屑' (sawdust) and '木板' (wood plank), which reduces the figurative meaning. '锯木屑' is more like sawdust rather than a speck, and '木板' is a literal plank, losing the metaphorical sense.

errors.source_span: How can you say to your brother, ‘Brother, let me take the speck out of your eye,’ when you yourself fail to see the plank in your own eye? You hypocrite, first take the plank out of your eye, and then you will see clearly to remove the speck from your brother’s eye.
errors.translation_span: 你怎能对你哥哥说:我从你的眼睛中取出那块斑点呢?你自认没有看见木板吗?你伪信者啊!你先把木板取出,然后,你看得清清楚楚,从你哥哥的眼中取出那块斑点。
errors.explanation: ‘斑点’ for 'speck' is not consistent with '锯木屑' in verse 41, causing inconsistency. '伪信者' (hypocrite) is awkward and inaccurate; the common and correct term is '假冒为善的人'. The translation also generalizes 'see clearly' as '看得清清楚楚' which is acceptable.

errors.source_span: No good tree bears bad fruit, nor does a bad tree bear good fruit.
errors.translation_span: 好的树没有坏的果实,坏的树也没有好的结果。
errors.explanation: Translation uses '结果' for 'fruit' in the second clause, which is different from '果实' used in the first clause, creating inconsistency and semantic deviation.

errors.source_span: People do not pick figs from thornbushes, or grapes from briers.
errors.translation_span: 人们不摘果,也不摘果。
errors.explanation: The translators omitted 'figs' and 'thornbushes', and 'grapes' and 'briers', replacing with incomplete and vague '不摘果', losing the content entirely.

errors.source_span: A good man brings good things out of the good stored up in his heart, and an evil man brings evil things out of the evil stored up in his heart. For the mouth speaks what the heart is full of.
errors.translation_span: 善人从心中储存的善事中创造善事,恶人从心中创造恶事,口中叙述心事,
errors.explanation: The translation conveys an inaccurate meaning: '创造' (create) is not the same as 'brings out' or 'speaks'. '口中叙述心事' (mouth narrates matters of the heart) is less faithful than 'mouth speaks what the heart is full of'. The source's clear cause-effect is lost.

errors.source_span: For the mouth speaks what the heart is full of.
errors.translation_span: 口中叙述心事,
errors.explanation: Phrase is incomplete; it lacks the explicit causal meaning that the mouth speaks what heart is full of.

errors.source_span: Why do you call me, ‘Lord, Lord,’ and do not do what I say?
errors.translation_span: 你为何召唤我——主啊!求你不要做我所说的话。
errors.explanation: The translation reverses meaning by saying '求你不要做我所说的话' ('please do not do what I say'), which is contrary to the source intent. It seriously distorts the source message.

errors.source_span: One Sabbath Jesus was going through the grainfields, and his disciples began to pick some heads of grain, rub them in their hands and eat the kernels.
errors.translation_span: 撒下9 又有一个安息日、他进了犹太会堂、教训人. 有一个人在那里、他的右手被砍了。
errors.explanation: The translation omits the event of Jesus and his disciples going through the grainfields and picking grain. Instead, it repeats a different verse about Jesus entering the synagogue and teaching, which is incorrect.

errors.source_span: Some of the Pharisees asked, “Why are you doing what is unlawful on the Sabbath?”
errors.translation_span: 法利赛人中有几个说、你们为什么在安息日行不法的事呢。
errors.explanation: The translation changes the verse order and context; '法利赛人中有几个说' lacks clarity and continuity because the prior verse content is incorrect, causing confusion about who is speaking and when.

errors.source_span: He entered the house of God, and taking the consecrated bread, he ate what is lawful only for priests to eat. And he also gave some to his companions.
errors.translation_span: 他进了神的殿,拿了圣洁的饼,吃了祭司吃不可的,还给同伴吃。
errors.explanation: The translation incorrectly states '吃了祭司吃不可的' (ate what priests are not allowed to eat), which reverses the meaning; the original says it is lawful only for priests to eat.

errors.source_span: Then Jesus said to them, “The Son of Man is Lord of the Sabbath.”
errors.translation_span: 耶稣对他们说、人子是安息的耶和华。
errors.explanation: The translation uses '安息的耶和华' (Lord of the rest/Sabbath) which is a non-standard phrase and can be confusing; the correct phrase is '安息日的主' (Lord of the Sabbath).

errors.source_span: On another Sabbath he went into the synagogue and was teaching, and a man was there whose right hand was shriveled.
errors.translation_span: 撒下9 又有一个安息日、他进了犹太会堂、教训人. 有一个人在那里、他的右手被砍了。
errors.explanation: The translation repeats previous incorrect text with reference '撒下9' and incorrectly says '右手被砍了' (right hand was cut off) instead of 'right hand was shriveled.' The reference format is also incorrect.

errors.source_span: The Pharisees and the teachers of the law were looking for a reason to accuse Jesus, so they watched him closely to see if he would heal on the Sabbath.
errors.translation_span: 法利赛人和律法师正在寻找理由来指责耶稣,所以他们密切观察他,看他是否能在安息日治愈。
errors.explanation: The translation changes 'heal' (治愈) to '能在安息日治愈' meaning 'can heal' which slightly alters the original meaning 'to see if he would heal' - a minor issue, but overall acceptable.

errors.source_span: I ask you, which is lawful on the Sabbath: to do good or to do evil, to save life or to destroy it?
errors.translation_span: 我问你们,安息日是合法的,是行善、是行恶、是救生、是毁灭生命。
errors.explanation: The translation incorrectly phrases the question making it a statement about the Sabbath being lawful rather than a question about what is lawful to do on Sabbath; context is lost.

errors.source_span: He looked around at them all, and then said to the man, “Stretch out your hand.” He did so, and his hand was completely restored.
errors.translation_span: 他看了他们四周,然后对那人说:“伸出你的手。” 他这样做,他的手完全恢复了。
errors.explanation: The translation is mostly accurate but '看了他们四周' is slightly awkward; better phrasing would clarify that he looked around at all of them.

errors.source_span: But the Pharisees and the teachers of the law were furious and began to discuss with one another what they might do to Jesus.
errors.translation_span: 但法利赛人和律法师都发怒,彼此商量他们对耶稣怎样行呢
errors.explanation: The translation omits an ending punctuation/question mark or continuation, making the phrase incomplete; though meaning is mostly clear.

errors.source_span: When morning came, he called his disciples to him and chose twelve of them, whom he also designated apostles:
errors.translation_span: 创8 早晨、他叫他的门徒来、从他们中选了十二人、并任命他们为使徒.
errors.explanation: The translation includes incorrect reference '创8' and does not fully convey the act of calling disciples to him; content is somewhat mixed with inaccurate references.

errors.source_span: James son of Alphaeus, Simon who was called the Zealot,
errors.translation_span: 雅各亚的儿子亚历山大、西门、名叫撒罗的、
errors.explanation: The translation misrenders 'Alphaeus' as '亚历山大' (Alexander), which is a distinct name, and 'Simon who was called the Zealot' as '西门、名叫撒罗的' which is an uncommon or incorrect transliteration, leading to confusion.

errors.source_span: and Judas Iscariot, who became a traitor.
errors.translation_span: 和叛国的犹大 Iscariot.
errors.explanation: The translation separates 'Iscariot' untranslated and appends it without proper integration; it mixes untranslated English and Chinese, which affects fluency and clarity.

errors.source_span: A large crowd of his disciples was there and a great number of people from all over Judea, from Jerusalem, and from the coastal region around Tyre and Sidon,
errors.translation_span: 那里有门徒大群、和犹大各地、耶路撒冷、 Tyre和Sidon的沿海地区、许多人、
errors.explanation: The translation omits 'a great number of people' as a continuous phrase and irregularly leaves 'Tyre' and 'Sidon' untranslated and without markers, disrupting fluency and consistency.

errors.source_span: Those troubled by impure spirits were cured,
errors.translation_span: 那些被污秽的灵所困扰的、都治愈了。
errors.explanation: The translation is generally accurate though 'impure spirits' is translated as '污秽的灵', which is acceptable but a less common phrasing.

errors.source_span: because power was coming from him and healing them all
errors.translation_span: 因为他有能力从他那里来医治他们
errors.explanation: The translation incorrectly states 'power coming from him' as 'he has power from him' which is confusing and deviates from meaning. Also, 'healing them all' is not clearly translated, making the meaning hard to recover.

errors.source_span: Blessed are you when people hate you, when they exclude you and insult you and reject your name as evil, because of the Son of Man
errors.translation_span: 你们是福的、当人恨你们、因人子而排斥你们、侮辱你们、把你们的名当作恶
errors.explanation: The translation omits the phrase 'Blessed are you when...' and instead states 'You are blessed, when...,' changing the structure and potentially the emphasis. Also, the phrase 'reject your name as evil' is translated as '把你们的名当作恶' which is acceptable but somewhat unclear without 'reject' explicitly translated.

errors.source_span: Rejoice in that day and leap for joy, because great is your reward in heaven. For that is how their ancestors treated the prophets.
errors.translation_span: 代上6:9 你们要在那日欢喜、跳跃、因为你们在天上所得的报酬甚大、因为他们祖先如此对待先知
errors.explanation: Text contains an irrelevant Bible reference ('代上6:9') inserted mistakenly, which disrupts fluency and is an extraneous addition.

errors.source_span: But woe to you who are rich, for you have already received your comfort.
errors.translation_span: 创8 你们富人、祸了、你们已经得到安慰
errors.explanation: The translation incorrectly inserts '创8' (Genesis 8) without context, which is an extraneous and confusing addition. The wording '你们富人、祸了' translates 'woe to you who are rich' properly, but the added reference is wrong.

errors.source_span: Woe to you when everyone speaks well of you, for that is how their ancestors treated the false prophets.
errors.translation_span: 诗119:9 你们都说你们好、你们的祖先就是这样对待假先知的
errors.explanation: The translation inserts an irrelevant scripture reference '诗119:9' and also changes the original wording 'when everyone speaks well of you' to '你们都说你们好' ('you all say you are good'), which is an inaccurate rendering altering the intended meaning.

errors.source_span: But to you who are listening I say: Love your enemies, do good to those who hate you
errors.translation_span: 赛9 你们听见我的话、我就对你们说、爱你们的仇敌、和恨你们的人行善
errors.explanation: Irrelevant insertion '赛9' (Isaiah 9) distracts from meaning. The phrase 'But to you who are listening I say' is translated as '你们听见我的话、我就对你们说', which is imprecise; it implies 'you hear my words, I tell you' instead of the conditional 'to you who listen'.

errors.source_span: If someone slaps you on one cheek, turn to them the other also. If someone takes your coat, do not withhold your shirt from them.
errors.translation_span: 若有人打你的一张面颊,就向他开另一张面颊;若有人把你的外套拿走,就不要把你的衬衫藏在他们身上
errors.explanation: The phrase 'turn to them the other also' is translated as '就向他开另一张面颊' (open the other cheek to him), which is an unnatural and inaccurate translation; it should be 'turn to him the other cheek.' Also, 'do not withhold your shirt' is incorrectly rendered as '不要把你的衬衫藏在他们身上' ('do not hide your shirt on them'), which is inaccurate and confusing.

errors.source_span: Give to everyone who asks you, and if anyone takes what belongs to you, do not demand it back.
errors.translation_span: 给所有要求你的人,如果有人拿了属于你的东西,不要要求它回来
errors.explanation: Missing appropriate conjunction between sentences resulting in a run-on. Also, 'do not demand it back' is less clearly expressed as '不要要求它回来' (do not ask it back), which is slightly weaker and less natural.

errors.source_span: Do to others as you would have them do to you.
errors.translation_span: 对别人做你所要求的那样
errors.explanation: The translation uses '你所要求的那样' which literally means 'as you demand', less natural than 'as you would have them do to you', but meaning is mostly recoverable.

errors.source_span: And if you lend to those from whom you expect repayment, what credit is that to you? Even sinners lend to sinners, expecting to be repaid in full.
errors.translation_span: 你若向那些你期望得到偿还的人借钱,那对你有甚麽好处呢? 罪人也借钱给罪人,希望得到全部偿还
errors.explanation: The phrase '你若向那些你期望得到偿还的人借钱' is ambiguous; it sounds like you borrow money from those you expect repayment, while the source means 'lend to those you expect repayment from'. This affects clarity.

errors.source_span: But love your enemies, do good to them, and lend to them without expecting to get anything back. Then your reward will be great, and you will be children of the Most High, because he is kind to the ungrateful and wicked.
errors.translation_span: 你们要爱你们的仇敌、对他们行善、向他们借钱、没有预料得到任何东西。 那时你们的报酬将是高大的、你们必是高尚的儿女。 因为他对不诚实的、wicked的人是仁慈的
errors.explanation: The phrase 'lend to them' is mistranslated as '向他们借钱' which means 'borrow money from them,' reversing the meaning. Also, 'Most High' is translated as '高尚的' (noble/high-minded), which is an inaccurate rendering. The untranslated English word 'wicked' remains in the text, which is an untranslated/non-translation error.

errors.source_span: Give, and it will be given to you.
errors.translation_span: 你们要赐给你、就必赐给你。
errors.explanation: The translation mistakenly reverses the meaning, implying 'you give to yourself' instead of 'give and you will receive.'

errors.source_span: A good measure, pressed down, shaken together and running over, will be poured into your lap.
errors.translation_span: 好的尺度、压下来、摇动起来、跑过去、必倒在你们的膝上。
errors.explanation: The phrase '跑过去' (running over/running away) is an incorrect rendering of 'running over' and is semantically odd here.

errors.source_span: “Can the blind lead the blind? Will they not both fall into a pit?
errors.translation_span: 瞎子能引导瞎子 吗 ? 难道他们两个都不是掉进坑里 呢 ?
errors.explanation: The phrase '都不是掉进坑里' is ungrammatical and should be corrected to something like '都会掉进坑里' to convey the intended meaning.

errors.source_span: but everyone who is fully trained will be like their teacher.
errors.translation_span: 但是完全受过训练的每个人都会像他们的老师。
errors.explanation: The source implies 'fully trained' or 'completely trained' but the translation conveys 'completely trained' which is acceptable and not a major issue. No penalty here.

errors.source_span: speck of sawdust
errors.translation_span: 那片锯木屑
errors.explanation: The translation uses '锯木屑' (sawdust) while the source likely implies a 'speck' or 'mote'; this is acceptable terminology and not penalized.

errors.source_span: You hypocrite, first take the plank out of your eye, and then you will see clearly to remove the speck from your brother’s eye.
errors.translation_span: 因为你自己看不见自己的眼睛里的斑点。
errors.explanation: The critical phrase calling 'You hypocrite' and the instruction to 'first take the plank out of your eye' is omitted or mistranslated, making the meaning incomplete and inaccurate.

errors.source_span: People do not pick figs from thornbushes, or grapes from briers.
errors.translation_span: 人们不从树丛中摘梨,也不从葡萄树中摘葡萄。
errors.explanation: The translation wrongly uses '梨' (pear) instead of '无花果' (fig), and '树丛' is an imprecise rendering of 'thornbushes'; this distorts the source meaning.

errors.source_span: Why do you call me, ‘Lord, Lord,’ and do not do what I say?
errors.translation_span: 你为什么叫我主,主,却不做我所说的呢?
errors.explanation: The translation omits 'do' in 'do what I say,' rendering it as 'not do what I say,' which can be understood but is less direct; however, this is a minor stylistic issue, so not penalized.

errors.source_span: I will show you what they are like.
errors.translation_span: 我必向你们显现。
errors.explanation: The meaning 'I will show you what they are like' is reduced to 'I will appear to you,' losing the illustration's intent.

errors.source_span: They are like a man building a house, who dug down deep and laid the foundation on rock.
errors.translation_span: 他们像 build a house 的一个人,挖到深处,把基石放在石头上。
errors.explanation: The untranslated English phrase 'build a house' is embedded awkwardly, indicating a literal untranslated segment and resulting in a fluency and partial untranslated error.

errors.source_span: When a flood came, the torrent struck that house but could not shake it, because it was well built.
errors.translation_span: 当洪水来的时候,大洪水击中那座房子,却不能摇动它,因为它是修好的。
errors.explanation: Translation '因为它是修好的' is a non-native phrase; '因为它建造坚固' would be better. Also, '击中' is awkward for 'struck.' This is a minor fluency issue.

errors.source_span: But the one who hears my words and does not put them into practice is like a man who built a house on the ground without a foundation.
errors.translation_span: 但谁听我的话而不实践,就象一个没有基础的男子在地上建造房子的人一样。
errors.explanation: The phrase '没有基础的男子' (a man without foundation) is a slightly awkward translation for 'built a house on the ground without a foundation,' minor clarity issue but acceptable.

errors.source_span: Jesus was going through the grainfields, and his disciples began to pick some heads of grain, rub them in their hands and eat the kernels
errors.translation_span: 耶稣进了犹太教堂
errors.explanation: The translation omits the context of Jesus passing through grainfields and his disciples picking and eating grain, instead saying Jesus entered the synagogue, which is a significant shift in setting and action.

errors.source_span: his disciples began to pick some heads of grain, rub them in their hands and eat the kernels
errors.translation_span: 就教训.那里有一个手的男人
errors.explanation: The translated phrase '就教训.那里有一个手的男人' (began teaching; there was a man with a hand) incorrectly renders the source which mentions disciples picking and eating grain, not teaching or a man with a shriveled hand at this point. This shifts the meaning and confuses verses 1-2.

errors.source_span: Some of the Pharisees asked, “Why are you doing what is unlawful on the Sabbath?”
errors.translation_span: 有法利赛人问他们:"你们为什么在安息日行违禁的呢?"
errors.explanation: Though the core idea is roughly present, the translation uses '行违禁的' (do forbidden things), which is less natural and less precise than 'doing what is unlawful' on the Sabbath, but this is a minor stylistic issue and acceptable. No penalty.

errors.source_span: Jesus answered them, “Have you never read what David did when he and his companions were hungry? He entered the house of God, and taking the consecrated bread, he ate what is lawful only for priests to eat. And he also gave some to his companions.”
errors.translation_span: 耶稣回答说:大卫和他同伴饥饿的时候,你们没有读过大卫所做的吗?他进了神的殿,拿了献给神的饼,吃了,除了祭司以外,没有法可以吃的,还给了他同行的.
errors.explanation: The translation slightly awkwardly phrases '除了祭司以外,没有法可以吃的' instead of 'only lawful for priests to eat,' which may cause minor clarity issues but does not cause loss of core meaning.

errors.source_span: Then Jesus said to them, “The Son of Man is Lord of the Sabbath.”
errors.translation_span: 耶稣又对他们说:人子是安息日的主.
errors.explanation: Accurate translation with acceptable phrasing.

errors.source_span: On another Sabbath he went into the synagogue and was teaching, and a man was there whose right hand was shriveled.
errors.translation_span: 又有一天安息日,耶稣进了犹太教堂,就教训.那里有一个手的男人.
errors.explanation: This verse is omitted in the initial position and incorrectly mixed with verse 1; the translation repeats the verse 1 text here, which causes confusion and omission of the original timeline and verses.

errors.source_span: But the Pharisees and the teachers of the law were furious and began to discuss with one another what they might do to Jesus.
errors.translation_span: 他们的心就然,他们就彼此商议,要怎样行耶稣.
errors.explanation: The phrase '他们的心就然' is unclear and awkward, possibly a typo or mistranslation of '心就愤怒' meaning furious; '要怎样行耶稣' is also incomplete or incorrect, lacking a verb after '行'. This causes a minor fluency and clarity problem.

errors.source_span: Simon who was called the Zealot
errors.translation_span: 西门,称为子
errors.explanation: 'Simon who was called the Zealot' is translated as '西门,称为子' (Simon, called Zi), which is incomplete or incorrect; the term 'Zealot' is untranslated or mistranslated, causing loss of a key identifier.

errors.source_span: Judas Iscariot, who became a traitor.
errors.translation_span: 卖卖的犹大斯加略特.
errors.explanation: The translation uses '卖卖的犹大斯加略特', which is a mistransliteration of 'Judas Iscariot' with an added or erroneous character '卖卖的' (which means 'selling'), possibly confusing the meaning; it should be a consistent and standard transliteration.

errors.source_span: ...from the coastal region around Tyre and Sidon, who had come to hear him and to be healed of their diseases. Those troubled by impure spirits were cured,
errors.translation_span: 西顿和罗边境,他们来听耶稣说话,被医治他们的病.被污秽的灵困扰的人也被医治.
errors.explanation: The translation replaces 'Tyre' with '罗边境' (border of Luo?), which is inaccurate; 'Tyre' and 'Sidon' are historical place names and should be transliterated or accurately translated. The last phrase is an acceptable paraphrase.

errors.source_span: because power was coming from him and healing them all
errors.translation_span: 因为从他里出来的力量都治愈了他们
errors.explanation: The translation loosely renders 'power was coming from him and healing them all' as '力量都治愈了他们' ('power healed them'), which slightly simplifies and omits the dynamic process of power coming from him. This is a minor omission affecting nuance but the overall meaning is mostly preserved.

errors.source_span: Looking at his disciples, he said:
errors.translation_span: 耶稣着眼睛看着门徒说
errors.explanation: The phrase '耶稣着眼睛看着门徒说' is awkward and grammatically incorrect due to the redundant '着' and poor phrasing. A better rendering would be '耶稣看着门徒说' or '耶稣注视着门徒说'.

errors.source_span: when they exclude you and insult you and reject your name as evil
errors.translation_span: 把你们排斥,谤,弃你们的名的时候
errors.explanation: The use of '谤' (to slander) alone here as parallel to 'exclude' and 'reject' is awkward and unclear in Chinese. A more natural phrase is needed to convey 'insult you'.

errors.source_span: Rejoice in that day and leap for joy, because great is your reward in heaven.
errors.translation_span: 那天,你们要欢喜,欢喜大大,因为你们在天上将得重大的报酬.
errors.explanation: The phrase '欢喜大大' is awkward and non-idiomatic in Chinese. '欢喜跳跃' or '欢欣鼓舞' better convey 'leap for joy'.

errors.source_span: Woe to you who laugh now, for you will mourn and weep.
errors.translation_span: 你们现在笑的人,有祸了,因为你们要哀哭哭.
errors.explanation: The phrase '哀哭哭' repeats '哭' unnecessarily, which is a fluency problem. No additional meaning is conveyed by the repetition.

errors.source_span: Woe to you when everyone speaks well of you, for that is how their ancestors treated the false prophets.
errors.translation_span: 人人都赞美你们,有祸了!他们的祖先也这样对假先知说话.
errors.explanation: The translation renders 'when everyone speaks well of you' as '人人都赞美你们' ('everyone praises you'), which is acceptable. However, '他们的祖先也这样对假先知说话' is an incorrect translation of 'that is how their ancestors treated the false prophets.' It means 'spoke to the false prophets' instead of 'treated' and loses the original emphasis on maltreatment. This is a mistranslation affecting core meaning.

errors.source_span: But to you who are listening I say: Love your enemies, do good to those who hate you,
errors.translation_span: 现在,我告诉你们听我的话,要爱你们的敌人,要行善你们的仇敌.
errors.explanation: The translation adds '现在' ('now') which is not in source; also '我告诉你们听我的话' is redundant and awkward compared to the simple biblical style. This is a minor stylistic addition but does not affect meaning.

errors.source_span: If someone takes your coat, do not withhold your shirt from them.
errors.translation_span: 谁拿你的子,就不要住你的衫.
errors.explanation: The words '拿你的子' and '住你的衫' seem to be mistranscribed or mistranslated. The original text talks about 'coat' and 'shirt'; here Chinese characters look incorrect or nonsensical representing these garments. This results in a major mistranslation causing confusion about the garments being referred to.

errors.source_span: Do to others as you would have them do to you.
errors.translation_span: 你们要怎样待别人,你们也要怎样待别人.
errors.explanation: The translation repeats '你们要怎样待别人' twice without expressing the reciprocal principle. The original sentence says 'do to others as you want done to you,' which is lost here. This is a major mistranslation reversing core meaning.

errors.source_span: If you love those who love you, what credit is that to you?
errors.translation_span: 你们若爱爱爱你们的,有甚麽荣誉呢?
errors.explanation: The phrase '爱爱爱你们的' repeats the verb '爱' three times, which is a typographical or fluency error.

errors.source_span: And if you do good to those who are good to you, what credit is that to you?
errors.translation_span: 你们若向你们行善的人行善,你们有甚麽荣誉呢?
errors.explanation: The translation is acceptable but uses '有甚麽荣誉呢?' for 'what credit is that to you?', which is better rendered as '有什么可夸的呢?' This is minor stylistic issue only.

errors.source_span: And if you lend to those from whom you expect repayment, what credit is that to you?
errors.translation_span: 你们若借给那些希望还给的人,那你们有什么荣誉呢?
errors.explanation: The translation is acceptable but stylistically awkward; '希望还给的人' is a literal but passable rendering. No significant error.

errors.source_span: Then your reward will be great, and you will be children of the Most High, because he is kind to the ungrateful and wicked.
errors.translation_span: 那么,你们的报酬将是大大的,你们就成为至高者的子孙,因为他对不感谢和不义的人是仁慈的.
errors.explanation: '报酬将是大大的' is a somewhat awkward phrasing for 'reward will be great,' and '不感谢和不义的人' literally 'unthankful and unrighteous' for 'ungrateful and wicked.' Minor stylistic inaccuracies but no meaning loss.

errors.source_span: A good measure, pressed down, shaken together and running over, will be poured into your lap.
errors.translation_span: 你们要拿着的,的,的,的,好的量,将倒在你们的怀里.
errors.explanation: The translation contains repeated and extraneous characters '的' multiple times, causing severe fluency issues and making the sentence unclear.

errors.source_span: For with the measure you use, it will be measured to you.
errors.translation_span: 因为你们用那量度,就用那量度,就会给你们.
errors.explanation: The translation is incomplete and unclear, omitting the conditional meaning and failing to convey that you will be measured by the same measure you use.

errors.source_span: The student is not above the teacher, but everyone who is fully trained will be like their teacher.
errors.translation_span: 学生不过老师,但凡经过训练的都就像老师.
errors.explanation: The translation omits the comparative 'not above' indicating the student's position relative to the teacher, which slightly diminishes meaning clarity.

errors.source_span: Why do you look at the speck of sawdust in your brother’s eye and pay no attention to the plank in your own eye?
errors.translation_span: 你为什么看着弟兄眼中的子,却不注意你自己的眼中的子呢?
errors.explanation: The key words 'speck of sawdust' and 'plank' are mistranslated or omitted with just '子' (zi) which is incomplete and unclear, losing the metaphor's contrast.

errors.source_span: How can you say to your brother, ‘Brother, let me take the speck out of your eye,’ when you yourself fail to see the plank in your own eye? You hypocrite, first take the plank out of your eye, and then you will see clearly to remove the speck from your brother’s eye.
errors.translation_span: 你怎能对你的弟兄说:弟兄,让我把那块从你的眼睛里拿出来,而你自己看不到自己的眼中的子呢?伪君啊,先把那块从你的眼睛里拿出来,然后你就能清楚地看见,把那块从你弟兄的眼睛里拿出来.
errors.explanation: The metaphoric terms 'speck' and 'plank' are mistranslated or confused. '那块' (that piece) is unclear and inconsistent, and the term '伪君' should be '伪君子'. The meaning is distorted and lacks precision.

errors.source_span: People do not pick figs from thornbushes, or grapes from briers.
errors.translation_span: 人们不从棘中摘果,也不是从树中摘葡萄.
errors.explanation: The source mentions 'thornbushes' and 'briers' specifically with figs and grapes; the translation omits 'figs' and uses an unclear phrase '棘' and '树' which is incomplete, leading to slight loss of detail.

errors.source_span: A good man brings good things out of the good stored up in his heart, and an evil man brings evil things out of the evil stored up in his heart. For the mouth speaks what the heart is full of.
errors.translation_span: 好人从心里积蓄的善中,拿出善,恶人从心里积蓄的恶中拿出恶.心里充满的口就说出.
errors.explanation: The last sentence is awkward and mistranslates 'For the mouth speaks what the heart is full of.' as '心里充满的口就说出.', which reverses subject and object and reduces clarity.

errors.source_span: Why do you call me, ‘Lord, Lord,’ and do not do what I say?
errors.translation_span: 你们为什么叫我说主,主,却不遵行我的话呢?
errors.explanation: The translation adds an extra verb '说' (say) after '叫我', which is unnecessary and awkward. The source phrase 'call me' is better directly translated as '叫我主'.

errors.source_span: began to pick some heads of grain, rub them in their hands and eat the kernels
errors.translation_span: 那里有一个人,他的右手了
errors.explanation: Translation omits the action of picking grain and eating kernels and instead mentions a man with a shriveled right hand, which belongs to verse 6, causing a displacement and omission of original content.

errors.translation_span: 他的右手了
errors.explanation: The phrase '他的右手了' is incomplete and ungrammatical, making it confusing.

errors.source_span: Some of the Pharisees asked, “Why are you doing what is unlawful on the Sabbath?”
errors.translation_span: 有法利赛人说:"你们为什么在安息日行不合法的呢?"
errors.explanation: The translation incorrectly uses '你们' (you plural) instead of the singular or a neutral way, which distorts who is being addressed, and the phrase '行不合法的' is an unnatural translation compared to '做违法的事'.

errors.source_span: And he also gave some to his companions
errors.translation_span: 给了同伴吃,这也是祭司以外别人不可以吃的
errors.explanation: The phrase is somewhat unclear; the original states the consecrated bread is lawful only for priests, but translation's '这也是祭司以外别人不可以吃的' is awkward and confusing.

errors.source_span: Then Jesus said to them, “The Son of Man is Lord of the Sabbath.”
errors.translation_span: 人子是安息日的主.
errors.explanation: The translation omits 'Then Jesus said to them' which introduces the statement, reducing clarity.

errors.source_span: On another Sabbath he went into the synagogue and was teaching, and a man was there whose right hand was shriveled.
errors.translation_span: 又有一个安息日,耶稣进了会堂教训人.那里有一个人,他的右手了.
errors.explanation: This verse is repeated earlier and again mistranslated. The phrase '他的右手了' is incomplete and the mention of the man is misplaced in verse 1 rather than verse 6.

errors.source_span: The Pharisees and the teachers of the law were looking for a reason to accuse Jesus, so they watched him closely to see if he would heal on the Sabbath.
errors.translation_span: 律法学家和法利赛人着耶稣,看他是否在安息日治病,要找可控的理由.
errors.explanation: The translation renders 'were looking for a reason to accuse Jesus' as '着耶稣' which is incomplete and unclear.

errors.source_span: But Jesus knew what they were thinking and said to the man with the shriveled hand, “Get up and stand in front of everyone.” So he got up and stood there.
errors.translation_span: 耶稣知道他们的思想,就对那手的说: "起来,站在中间吧!"他就起来,站在那里.
errors.explanation: The phrase '对那手的说' is incomplete; should be '对那有枯干手的人说', a grammatical issue causing minor clarity problems.

errors.source_span: One of those days Jesus went out to a mountainside to pray, and spent the night praying to God.
errors.translation_span: 在那一天,耶稣上山祷告,一夜都在祷告神.
errors.explanation: Translation omits 'went out to a mountainside' specifying location as a mountainside; '上山' is less specific but acceptable.

errors.source_span: because power was coming from him and healing them all
errors.translation_span: 因为有能力从他身上出来,治好他们
errors.explanation: The phrase 'power was coming from him' suggests a continuous emanation of power, but the translation uses '有能力从他身上出来' which is a somewhat unnatural expression in Chinese, potentially confusing the meaning. A more natural phrasing would better convey the continuous healing power flowing from him.

errors.source_span: Blessed are you who are poor, for yours is the kingdom of God
errors.translation_span: 你们穷人有福了,因为神的国是你们的
errors.explanation: The source uses 'God' while the translation uses '神', which is acceptable; however, the syntactic order in Chinese is slightly awkward and could be more naturally rendered as '因为天国是你们的' or '因为你们属神的国' to match common biblical terminology.

errors.source_span: bless those who curse you, pray for those who mistreat you
errors.translation_span: 祝福咒诅你们的,为欺负你们的祷告
errors.explanation: The term '欺负' (bully) is less precise than 'mistreat'. The original implies broader mistreatment; a better translation might be '为虐待你们的祷告' or '为亏负你们的祷告'. Also, '祝福咒诅你们的' exactly matches 'bless those who curse you' but '咒诅' is correctly used.

errors.source_span: If someone takes your coat, do not withhold your shirt from them
errors.translation_span: 人若夺走你的外衣,就不要不给他你的子
errors.explanation: The last word '子' is incomplete or missing one character and is unclear. The intended word is '衬衫' (shirt) or '里衣'. The omission leads to loss of meaning and confusion.

errors.source_span: expecting to be repaid in full
errors.translation_span: 盼望回报一点
errors.explanation: The translation uses '盼望回报一点' ('hoping to get back a little'), which diminishes the original meaning 'expecting to be repaid in full.' This changes the meaning and should be corrected to reflect full repayment expectation.

errors.source_span: A good measure, pressed down, shaken together and running over, will be poured into your lap.
errors.translation_span: 你们要用一把满满的,满的,满满的量给自己
errors.explanation: The translation inaccurately renders the imagery and meaning of 'pressed down, shaken together and running over' as '满满的,满的,满满的量给自己', which is awkward and does not capture the pressing down and shaking together process, and also incorrectly adds '给自己' (to yourself) which is not in the source.

errors.source_span: People do not pick figs from thornbushes, or grapes from briers.
errors.translation_span: 人从棘里摘无花果,从棘里摘葡萄
errors.explanation: The source says 'thornbushes' and 'briers' as two different plants, but the translation uses '棘' (thornbush) twice, conflating the two distinct source terms.

errors.source_span: A good man brings good things out of the good stored up in his heart, and an evil man brings evil things out of the evil stored up in his heart.
errors.translation_span: 好人从心里充满的好财富里拿出好财富;坏人从心里充满的坏财富里拿出坏财富
